attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the address carries exactly the declared permission bits; the constructor validates its own bits so a mis-mined salt reverts the launch
attributes.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey. It binds exactly one pool once at afterInitialize, precommitting the exact launch token, start price and tick spacing so a front-runner cannot capture it with a foreign pool. It accrues the mandatory Programmable volume fee on the executed gross quote-side amount across all four swap quadrants, skims the project slice into a self-funded monotonic price-floor reserve, and on an exact-input sell tops the seller up from that reserve toward the floor after the AMM executes the full swap.

attributes.callerRestriction: deployAndLaunch reverts unless msg.sender is the launch wallet fixed in the constructor, and reverts on any second call
attributes.residualBalance: every unspent unit of both currencies is returned to the launch wallet before the transaction ends
attributes.summary: Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position and settles both currencies; any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.

attributes.addressDerivation: CREATE2 from the launcher, with the salt mined until the predicted address sorts above the WETH9 address so WETH is currency0 and the launched token is currency1
attributes.summary: Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists, so the hook's bind-time supply snapshot equals the live supply forever.

attributes.ordering: after the token, so the mined hook salt commits the exact launched token, start price and tick spacing
first, so its address fixes the PoolKey currency ordering and the hook's precommitted token

attributes.failureRule: a foreign token, a mismatched start price or tick spacing, an unexpected delta or an over-budget settlement reverts the whole launch
attributes.steps: PoolManager.initialize on the canonical dynamic-fee key, then afterInitialize binds the pool and snapshots the backing supply, then unlock and modifyLiquidity for one full-range position, then sync, transfer and settle for each owed currency
